c74object.name: evi_dfm_lib
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_dfm_lib.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_dfm_lib.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_dfm_lib.genexpr file also requires:
evi_smooth.genexpr
evi_sources.genexpr
evi_interp.genexpr
About this File:
This file is a specific genexpr lib for use by the [evi.dfm~] MSP abstraction. It is likely not useful as a require() but you may find something interesting here. The enclosed [evi_dfm] gen~ abstraction only works in MSP as it requires an external LUT. [evi.dfm~] is a deluxe but dirty MS20-inspired old-school-style filter emulation, 12dB lowpass or 6dB highpass. Based on a classic by Tony Hardie-Bick ('DFM-1 Digital Filter Module'), 2010. LICENSE: GPLv2.

entry.name: gaussnoise ( )
entry.description:
Wrap box-muller gaussian noise with local gain stage
In 1: type=input: ngain, Gain (linear)
Return 1: Noise, Post gain gaussian noise

entry.name: dnl ( )
entry.description:
Cubic nonlinearity suggested by Tony Hardie-Bick
In 1: type=input: x0, Audio input
Return 1: Cubic, Saturated output

entry.name: dnl3x ( )
entry.description:
Quasi 3x oversampling of 'dnl()'
In 1: type=input: XIN, Audio input
Return 1: Cubic, Saturated output

entry.name: dnlNonlin ( )
entry.description:
Make oversampling choice on nonlinearity
In 1: type=input: xin, Audio input
In 2: type=input: oversampling, (int) 0=1x, 1=3x
Return 1: ,

entry.name: dft ( )
entry.description:
The filter (1x)
In 1: type=input: x, Audio input
In 2: type=input: l, Lowpass gain
In 3: type=input: h, Highpass gain
In 4: type=input: a, Stage 1 coefficient (factor of cutoff & lut)
In 5: type=input: b, Stage 2 coefficient (factor of cutoff & lut)
In 6: type=input: r, Resonance corrected (factor of cutoff, resonance & lut)
In 7: type=input: noisegain, Noise injection level
In 8: type=input: POSTGAIN, Postgain constant
In 9: type=input: HEADROOM, Headroom gain (factor of noise in filter)
In 10: type=input: nl, IGNORE: unused (should always be '0')
Return 1: DFM, Filtered audio output

entry.name: dfts ( )
entry.description:
The filter, make oversampling etc choice on entire filter
In 1: type=input: x, Audio input
In 2: type=input: l, Lowpass gain
In 3: type=input: h, Highpass gain
In 4: type=input: a, Stage 1 coefficient (factor of cutoff & lut)
In 5: type=input: b, Stage 2 coefficient (factor of cutoff & lut)
In 6: type=input: r, Resonance corrected (factor of cutoff, resonance & lut)
In 7: type=input: N, Noise injection level
In 8: type=input: os, Oversampling choice, fades between 1..2..1 if filter switched lowpass..highpass..lowpass, otherwise (int 0, 1, 2) selector
Return 1: DFM, Filtered audio output
